title:
AGI Open 2025,
Ho Chi Minh City
story: Two days at AGI Open in Ho Chi Minh City, learning from some of the world's most respected designers. Meeting Porto Rocha and Lisa Enebeis turned names on a screen into real conversations, and reminded me that good design is clarity, earned through care.
